project_name: Omega Framework - Multi-Agent AI Pipeline System

colors.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / CYBERDROME COMMAND CENTER

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#12141D]/80 border border-[#2A2E43]/60 shadow-lg shadow-black/40
visual_enhancers.terminal_style: bg-[#06070B] border border-[#2A2E43] rounded-lg p-4 font-mono text-xs text-slate-300 shadow-inner
visual_enhancers.active_pulse: relative after:content-[''] after:absolute after:-inset-0.5 after:bg-sky-500/30 after:rounded-full after:animate-ping

bento_ratios.header_stats: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3 mb-6

prd_input_screen.description: Upload markdown file or paste PRD text, select project name, select LLM model / sandbox config, and triggering the Start Pipeline CTA button

live_pipeline_header.description: Displays overall pipeline phase (Architecture → Planning → Coding → Review → Fixing → Done), progress bar with completed_tasks/total_tasks, and active iteration metrics

agent_activity_bar.description: Active agent indicator badges (Architect, Planner, Coder, Reviewer, Fixer) with glowing status animations when active

kanban_board.description: 5 columns (TODO, IN PROGRESS, REVIEW, DONE, FAILED) with task cards displaying ID, title, agent role, capabilities, iteration count, and status badges

architecture_spec_viewer.description: JSON viewer displaying generated project structure, modules, tech stack, and dependencies

realtime_log_stream.description: Live virtualized terminal log viewer with timestamped log levels, phase filters, search, and expandable raw LLM responses toggle

generated_project_explorer.description: Directory tree file browser for generated/ folder with syntax-highlighted code editor preview panel

runs_history_drawer.description: Historical runs table with status, duration, task counts, and reload capability

config_panel.description: omega.yaml configuration viewer & editor for local Ollama models, max iteration caps, and sandbox execution settings

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text against #090A0F and #12141D backgrounds
accessibility.hover_states: explicit text color set on hover states to prevent dark-on-dark contrast failure

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files strictly as setup in frontend project (not .tsx).
All main views and widgets must include appropriate data-testid attributes for testing compatibility.
Implement real code file simulation in generated/ file tree with tabbed code viewer.
Support dark IDE theme with crisp borders (#2A2E43) and vibrant agent status indicators.
Ensure interactive components use Shadcn/UI primitives customized with dark Tailwind styles.
Include toast feedback via Sonner for actions like 'Pipeline Started', 'Task Completed', 'File Exported'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and light mode default styles.
Create depth using visual layering, subtle neon glows, and glassmorphism cards.
Keep spacing generous (p-6/p-8) within card components to avoid text collisions.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000); use deep obsidian navy (#090A0F) as background.
Ensure explicit text colors on hover states (e.g. hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-sky-400).
